# A PR description stays under 40 lines

## Rule

A pull request's description is under 40 lines, in the sections the `github-pr` skill names.

## Why

Reviewers read the description before the diff, and long ones were skimmed.

## Examples

- Follows it: a 22-line description with what and why, how it was verified and what was left out.
- Breaks it: a 90-line description that repeats the diff file by file.
